title: Agent skill pack
description: A bundle of agent skills — either a vendor-published pack, a curated catalogue, or a public registry. One entry per pack, not per individual skill: the catalogue describes where to get skills and what they need, rather than duplicating a registry's contents.

id.description: Immutable slug, unique across every category in the repo.

provider.description: Who publishes and maintains the pack.

category.description: catalog = first-party curated set (openai/skills, anthropics/skills). vendor-pack = published by a product vendor for its own API. registry = a public marketplace of third-party skills. community = an individual maintainer's pack.

skill_count.description: Number of skills in the pack as published by the maintainer, when stated.

verified.description: ISO date the URL and stated counts were last checked.

notes.description: Caveats worth reading. A string or a list of strings.
